notes: DRAFT, revisions PENDING: the 200-report test set, the physician rating sheet and every baseline revision are pinned before the bake-off (around month 8), which re-locks the plan. Task: write the report from the findings JSON (helioslm_v5/eval/grounded_report.py schema), same prompt for every model (examples/grounded_report_run.py), temperature 0. report_grounding = facts the findings JSON does not support (the grader's unverified facts plus contradictions, i.e. values that differ from the nodule they are stated for), summed over all reports and all three seeds; the gate is that it is exactly 0. report_omission = omitted required fields / required fields (reported, not gated). physician_rating = mean radiologist score per report (external de-identified summary file; rows model, report_id, optional seed, score), ours averaged over three seeds. Claude Sonnet 5.5 is a reference ceiling, HeliosLM-B1 without the PulmoGuard SFT shows what the SFT adds; neither is gated.
